tasks.check: deno task check:sources && deno task check:tests
tasks.check:sources: DENO_BIN=$(deno run scripts/deno-executable.ts "$DENO_BIN") && DENO_BIN="$DENO_BIN" deno run --allow-env=PATH,HOME,TMPDIR,TEMP,TMP,DENO_BIN --allow-read=. --allow-run="$DENO_BIN" scripts/typecheck.ts sources
tasks.check:tests: DENO_BIN=$(deno run scripts/deno-executable.ts "$DENO_BIN") && DENO_BIN="$DENO_BIN" deno run --allow-env=PATH,HOME,TMPDIR,TEMP,TMP,DENO_BIN --allow-read=. --allow-run="$DENO_BIN" scripts/typecheck.ts tests
tasks.test:unit: DENO_BIN=$(deno run scripts/deno-executable.ts "$DENO_BIN") && DENO_BIN="$DENO_BIN" deno run --allow-env=PATH,HOME,TMPDIR,TEMP,TMP,DENO_BIN,DENO_JOBS,NODE_V8_COVERAGE --allow-read=. --allow-run="$DENO_BIN",node scripts/run-unit-tests.ts
tasks.test: DENO_BIN=$(deno run scripts/deno-executable.ts) && DENO_BIN="$DENO_BIN" deno task check && DENO_BIN="$DENO_BIN" deno task test:unit
tasks.test:golden: DENO_BIN=$(deno run scripts/deno-executable.ts) && DENO_BIN="$DENO_BIN" deno run --allow-env=PATH,HOME,TMPDIR,TEMP,TMP,DENO_BIN,NODE_V8_COVERAGE --allow-read=. --allow-write=/tmp,/private/tmp,/var/folders,/private/var/folders --allow-run="$DENO_BIN",node testing/golden/run.ts
tasks.test:file: bash -c 'test $# -gt 0 || { echo "usage: deno task test:file <path>... [--filter <pattern>]" >&2; exit 2; }; DENO_BIN=$(deno run scripts/deno-executable.ts) && DENO_BIN="$DENO_BIN" exec deno run --allow-env=PATH,HOME,TMPDIR,TEMP,TMP,DENO_BIN,DENO_JOBS,NODE_V8_COVERAGE --allow-read=. --allow-run="$DENO_BIN",node scripts/run-unit-tests.ts "$@"' dyfj-test-file
tasks.codex-chatgpt-login: /bin/sh -c 'node_path=${DYFJ_NODE_PATH:-}; if [ -z "$node_path" ]; then node_path=$(command -v node 2>/dev/null) || node_path=; fi; case "$node_path" in *[,:]*) node_path=;; esac; case "$HOME" in /*) ;; *) echo "dyfj: codex-chatgpt-login requires an absolute home path" >&2; exit 1;; esac; case "$HOME" in *[,:]*) echo "dyfj: codex-chatgpt-login home path contains an unsupported delimiter" >&2; exit 1;; esac; if [ -z "$node_path" ] || [ "${node_path#/}" = "$node_path" ] || [ ! -f "$node_path" ] || [ ! -x "$node_path" ]; then echo "dyfj: codex-chatgpt-login requires an absolute operator-authorized executable on PATH or in DYFJ_NODE_PATH" >&2; exit 1; fi; DYFJ_NODE_PATH="$node_path" exec deno run --no-prompt --allow-env=HOME,USER,DYFJ_NODE_PATH --allow-read=".,$node_path,$HOME,$HOME/.dyfj,$HOME/.dyfj/runner-homes,$HOME/.dyfj/runner-homes/codex-chatgpt" --allow-write="$HOME/.dyfj,$HOME/.dyfj/runner-homes,$HOME/.dyfj/runner-homes/codex-chatgpt" --allow-run="bash,$node_path" --allow-sys=uid scripts/codex-chatgpt-login.ts'
